info.title: API-DocTest-Delete Airline Flights Cancel-v1-spec
info.description: The Cancel Airline Flights API enables authorized users to effectively manage flight cancellations within the airline system. This endpoint supports the operational need to cancel scheduled flights, ensuring that both travel agents and airline staff can update flight statuses in real-time. Typical consumers include airline operators, backend services, and travel agency platforms looking to provide seamless customer service and real-time updates. By leveraging this API, stakeholders can reduce customer inconvenience and optimize flight scheduling operations.

delete.description: This operation allows you to cancel a previously booked flight. Ensure that you have the correct flight details and booking credentials before proceeding with the cancellation.

requestBody.description: Request body for cancelling a flight. This should contain the necessary details required to process the cancellation request.

DeleteAirlineFlightsCancelRequest.description: This schema represents the request body for the DELETE operation on flight cancellations. It should contain details relevant to the cancellation request.

DeleteAirlineFlightsCancelResponse_200.title: Flight Cancellation Response

status.description: Indicates whether the cancellation was successful.

referenceNumber.description: The reference number associated with the cancellation request.

resultId.description: A unique identifier for the result of the operation.

state.description: The current state of the cancellation request.

processingTimeMs.description: The time it took to process the cancellation request, in milliseconds.

message.description: A message providing additional information about the cancellation result.

audit.description: Information about the auditing of the cancellation operation.

DeleteAirlineFlightsCancelResponse_200.description: A response schema representing the outcome of a flight cancellation operation.

AuditInfo.title: Audit Information

createdBy.description: The user who initiated the cancellation operation.

createdAt.description: The timestamp when the operation was created.

automated.description: Indicates whether the cancellation operation was performed automatically.

AuditInfo.description: Contains information about the user and timestamp related to the operation.

x-processing-time.description: Indicates the amount of time, in milliseconds, that the server took to process the request.
